provenance.paper: S. V. Barron et al., Observable Estimation in the Absence of Classical Verification, arXiv:2607.25998v1 (2026)
provenance.circuits: Quantum Advantage Tracker, data/observable-estimations/circuit-models/operator_loschmidt_echo/operator_loschmidt_echo_56x1488_alpha_*.qasm, commit 1db844f1540a198c5620af49247e09fc28e7f61b; vendored gzipped under examples/data/ole56/
provenance.qubit_sets: derived from the QASM files by examples/b8_ole/ole.py and asserted against them in examples/tests/test_showcase_b8.py
provenance.parameters: arXiv:2607.25998 App. A 2 c (Eq. A13, eta list), App. C 5 (delta, generator, cache), Table I (reference values)

ppmc.rule: exact Pauli propagation with light coefficient truncation; after any gate that leaves more than `cache` strings, normalize and draw one string with probability b_P^2 / sum b^2, restart from it with coefficient 1; keep the full sum at the end
ppmc.estimator: S_diag = sum_P b_P^2 cos(2 delta)^{n_P} / sum_P b_P^2, n_P = number of perturbation sites whose X anticommutes with P; one trajectory per seed; mean and standard error over trajectories
ppmc.paper_cost: about 25 min on 32 cores and 65-102 GB peak RSS per trajectory at cache 5e8 (Table VI)

table_I.source: arXiv:2607.25998 Table I: eta = 9*pi/40 (tracker alpha 0.15), delta = 0.3

fig21.source: arXiv:2607.25998 Fig. 21 (p. 48), L = 6, delta = 0.3, read from the PDF's vector paths: marker centres and error-bar half-lengths against the gridlines (calibration residual < 0.003 plot units)
